analysis_type: Read-only post-hoc comparison of maximum residual-bound points and full-point distributions; no refitting or new experiment

rules.majority: Compare prediction-shift and snapshot-residual dominant counts; a tie would be retained as tie_no_single_majority rather than forcing a winner
rules.maximum_share: Use the stored maximum-bound point shift_share without recomputing the fitted model or changing the 0.5 threshold
rules.median_gap: maximum_shift_share minus median shift_share over all available points with a defined share
rules.descriptive_percentile: Count defined shares less than or equal to the maximum-point share and divide by available point count; this is a descriptive rank, not probability
rules.bound_ratio: maximum_residual_upper_bound divided by median residual_upper_bound; require positive median and retain the ratio separately from share class
rules.scope: Unavailable points remain excluded and are never converted to zero shares

prohibitions: No use of a maximum point as a typical or representative observation
No conversion of descriptive percentiles, shares or ratios into probabilities or physical causal contributions
No single mechanism or single scalar ranking across datasets
No erasure of Gauss1's majority mismatch, ENSO's actual-residual maximum or the six below-median maxima
